criteria: Inventory unit: a top-level Kyverno policy document in a sample package; fixtures and third-party Policy resources are not sample units.
All legacy ClusterPolicy, Policy, ClusterCleanupPolicy and CleanupPolicy samples are removed, including legacy CEL-expression variants.
Eligible replacements are new CEL policy kinds retained at policies.kyverno.io/v1; existing v1alpha1/v1beta1 CEL samples are normalized without changing their specs.
Equivalent requires substantive behavioral coverage: resource kinds and scope, match/exclude conditions, all rules, expressions/actions, autogeneration and background behavior where applicable.
Names, descriptions and directory suffixes identify candidates but do not establish equivalence.
Partial candidates have material gaps and are included in the upstream missing-policy tasklist.
Results are static behavioral assessments supplemented by available fixture comparisons; they are not claims of live-cluster semantic equivalence.
